purpose: non-agent baseline experiments for fixed-case qualification

candidate_rules: first complete day in each quarter of earliest complete data year
complete day with greatest integrated active demand in entire source
complete day with greatest integrated PV active energy in entire source
mapdn.reference: full-information AC OPF on shortlisted complete days

powergym.candidate_rule: six evenly spaced profile indices including first and last, deduplicated
powergym.reference: current-snapshot full-model coordinate search, battery idle

eligibility: complete source provenance and full horizon
physical convergence and valid actions for at least one declared reference
runtime compatible with target evaluation constraints
shortlist_order: standard and stress tracks remain separate
remaining voltage-control gap after stronger causal baseline
actual-loss gap to reference at comparable voltage compliance
runtime and action cost as explicit tie-break evidence
